milestones.title: Lemma 3.1 — Two-sided binomial entropy bounds
milestones.milestone_description: For integers $r\ge1$ and $0\le k\le r$, let $p=k/r$. Then $$\frac{e^{rH(p)}}{r+1}\le\binom rk\le e^{rH(p)}.$$ The endpoints $k=0,r$ are included. This is a standard estimate used by the manuscript, not a novelty claim.

milestones.title: Lemma 3.2 — Sharp normalized binomial tail
milestones.milestone_description: Let $c>10$ and $m\ge1$ be integers, $0<\theta<0.9$, $L=cm$, $D=4^m$, $t=\lceil\theta m\rceil$, $\beta_d=\binom L{m-d}9^{L-m+d}$ and $M=\beta_0$. Then $$\frac1M\sum_{d=t}^{m}\beta_d\le\frac{cm+1}{1-9/(c-1)}D^{-\gamma_*(c,\theta)}.$$ The ceiling is part of the statement; $t=m$ is included.

milestones.title: Proposition 3.3 — Strict improvement of the preprocessing saving
milestones.milestone_description: For every real $c>10$ and $0<\theta<0.9$, $$\gamma_*(c,\theta)>\gamma(c,\theta)>0.$$ This compares preprocessing savings at the same parameters. It does not by itself establish a smaller 3SUM running-time exponent.

milestones.title: Propositions 4.1 and 5.1 — From admissible sharp-tail parameters to the shared 3SUM specification
milestones.milestone_description:
Let $c>10$ be an integer, $0<\theta<0.9$, and let $a,s,r$ be rational with $0<a<1$ and $0<s<1$. Suppose
$$a(A(c)+\gamma_*(c,\theta))<1,\qquad s<\gamma_*(c,\theta),\qquad s<\tfrac12-q(\theta),$$
$$\log_2 7+\tfrac32a<3-as/2,\qquad 2+a(1+s/2)<3-as/2,\qquad r>2-as/4.$$
Then deterministic integer 3SUM satisfies the campaign's exact shared predicate `EndStatement.ThreeSum.SolvedInTime r`. This is the combined consequence of Propositions 4.1 and 5.1, not a verbatim separate proposition in the manuscript. Its proof must construct the word-RAM program and establish correctness and all costs using the inherited algorithms and reductions. No inner-algorithm oracle or correctness assumption is supplied as a hypothesis. The uniform word-width requirement in the shared specification is part of the formalization obligation.

milestones.title: Section 6.2 — Exact parameter inequalities for exponent 1.999017
milestones.milestone_description: For the exact rational parameters $c=21$, $\theta=0.11202$, $a=0.05665$, $s=0.06945$, establish $a(A+\gamma_*)<1$, $s<\gamma_*$, $s<1/2-q$, $\log_2 7+3a/2<3-as/2$, and $2+a(1+s/2)<3-as/2$. Also establish the exact equalities $$2-as/4=1.999016414375,\qquad 1.999017-(2-as/4)=0.000000585625.$$ All decimal constants denote exact rationals (coerced to reals in the analytic inequalities). The source's rational interval checks are reproducible evidence; proving this Lean statement remains a formalization task.
